spanish: la tienda de reunión y el arca del testimonio y la cubierta que *está* sobre ella, y todos los utensilios de la tienda,

units.es: y la cubierta que *está* sobre ella
y todos los utensilios de la tienda

grammarChanges: Replaced the untranslated lemma kappóret with the Spanish common noun cubierta per the cited auditor fail on h02031007008.
Added missing definite article: la tienda de reunión.
Corrected preposition: al testimonio → del testimonio.
Supplied the italicized copula está for the verbless relative clause (אשר עליו has no verb in source).
Changed él to ella so the pronoun agrees with el arca, which is grammatically feminine in Spanish.
Added missing article: todos los utensilios.
readerNote: Supplied the copula *está* for the verbless relative clause and used ella, not él, to agree with el arca, which is grammatically feminine in Spanish though it takes the article el.
